notes: CVE-2026-23864 is the React 19.0.4 DoS round; the Next advisory (GHSA-h25m-26qc-wcjf) covers >=13.0.0 <15.0.8 and has no 14.x patch. At v14.2.24 the vendored reply decoder is 18.3.0-canary-178c267a4e-20241218 and its decodeAction re-decodes every duplicate $ACTION_REF_ field with no dedup, while parseModelString case K rescans the whole FormData per reference, so repeated fields cost O(N^2).
The 15.0.8 fix 99b450109dfd syncs the React DoS mitigations by re-pinning react/react-dom to 19.0.0-rc-4cd8f914-20260126; upstream the hardening commit is de58cca00cf0 (19.0.4).

The row is source_review, not fix_diff_comparison: no 14.x patch exists and the missing guards (seenActions, MAX_BOUND_ARGS, arraySizeLimit) are verified by absence in both development and production bundles rather than by a literal pre-image hunk.

CVE-2026-23869 and CVE-2026-23870 stay possible_affected: their 19.0.5/19.0.6 fixes harden constructs ($$consumed, deferred reply FormData) that the 18.3 bundle does not contain at all, so the mapping from the fix to this tree is not established.
